Sjællands Universitetshospital is a university hospital located in Region Sjælland, Denmark [^src1]. It is featured in the DANIBD 2025 report, which serves as the national quality database for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) [^src1]. The hospital is listed among the healthcare units with registrations in Appendix Table 5 on page 47, which details the clinical use of biological treatments and surgical procedures among IBD patients [^src1]. 

The data provided for the hospital in this appendix includes specific patient counts and statistical metrics that contribute to the evaluation of treatment variations, surgical practices, and access to advanced therapies at both the regional and national levels [^src1]. Because the available documentation consists solely of a single statistical row in a technical appendix table, further narrative details regarding the hospital's specific clinical outcomes, leadership, or operational history are not available in this corpus.
